submitted.rationale: Out of three spaced samples along the Pb–Sb line, the Pb-rich index 4 (Pb0.69Sb0.31) had the highest EQE, 0.0215%. That is about 8x the Pb2Sb2O7-stoichiometry sample (index 14, 0.0028%) and about 23x the PbSb2O6-region sample (index 23, 0.00094%). EQE rises toward the Pb-rich end. All three measurements were used in one non-adaptive batch, so the Pb-rich end (indices 0–3) was never tested and may hold a higher optimum.

rejected.reason: Near-Pb2Sb2O7 pyrochlore composition, EQE 0.0028%, 8x lower than index 4
